snippet.title: "Prison Princess: Trapped Allure" Trailer ENG
snippet.description:
A long-awaited sequel to Prison Princess!
Go forth and rescue the Hero's Party, who have been screwed by the Demon King Hamehameha!

At long last a completely new sequel to Prison Princess, the mystery-solving adventure game where you guide princesses to escape the clutches of the Demon King!
The Hero's party meets an untimely demise on their path to defeating the Demon King?!
Turned into a spirit once more, the Hero must join forces with a new princess he meets in the Demon Castle to solve a plethora of puzzles and rescue his allies who have been captured and strewn screwed all over the castle.

■Character■
・Julietta       (Voice : Moe Toyota）
・Aria          (Voice : Mao Amatsuka）
・Zena    (Voice : Fumiko Uchimura）
・Charlotte   (Voice : Yuki Tanaka）
・Finanche    (Voice : Honoka Inoue）
・Chouquette    (Voice : Ayumi Mano）
・Ganache    (Voice : Haruka Shamoto）
・Souffle    (Voice : IchikaTachibana）
・Crafti    (Voice : Harada Sayaka）

・Demon King Hamehameha    (Voice : Mikoi Sasaki）

■STAFF■
・Character Design:Waon Inui,MIZU
・Scenario:Linkedbrain Inc.
・Producer:Yujiro Usuda

■SPEC■
・Game Title:Prison Princess: Trapped Allure
・Release Date:【Nintendo Switch】November 21, 2024
　　　　　　　【STEAM】November 21, 2024
・Platform:STEAM, Nintendo Switch
・Genre:Dating sim adventure
・Price:$19.99
・Supported Number of Players:1
・Supported Text Languages:Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
・Voice Language:Japanese
